relationships.subject: EGR1
relationships.evidence_quote: We quantified the number of EGR1 mRNAs localized to hDRG neurons and found it to be more abundant in female compared to male

key_findings: Bulk and spatial ATAC-seq of human DRG show sex differences: female DARs concentrate on the X chromosome (EGR/SP motifs), male DARs on autosomes (AP-1 motifs).
EGR1 expression is female-biased in SCN10A+ hDRG neurons and XIST is dispersed in female neuronal nuclei, suggesting incomplete X inactivation.
